# Configuration

Every option of `~/.config/amitty/config.toml`, by its TOML key, with its default. The first run writes the file with every option commented out; uncomment one to change it (see [Install and run](install.md)).

## Top level

| Option | Default | Meaning |
|--------|---------|---------|
| `auto_focus` | `false` | Whether to focus the composer when a channel is opened from the guilds tree. Off, the focus stays in the tree. |
| `mouse` | `true` | Whether to enable the mouse. |
| `editor` | `"default"` | The program opened by the `composer.open_editor` keybind. "default" uses `$EDITOR`. |
| `file_picker` | `""` | The program the `composer.open_file_picker` keybind runs in place of amitty's path prompt, such as "fzf --multi" or "yazi --chooser-file={file}"; "" uses the prompt. It runs in the terminal while amitty is suspended. It writes the chosen paths, one per line, to stdout, or to the file named where `{file}` is written. |
| `openers` | `{}` | Programs that open attachments by MIME type, and links by the key "url", in place of `xdg-open`, such as `{ "video/*" = { command = "mpv {}" }, "text/plain" = { command = "nvim {}", terminal = true }, url = { command = "firefox {}" } }`. `{}` is replaced by the file or link, which is appended when there is no `{}`. An exact type wins over a wildcard. A command runs in the background unless `terminal = true`, which suspends amitty while it runs. |
| `token-encrypt-cmd` | `"gpg --encrypt --default-recipient-self"` | The command that encrypts the token: it reads the token on stdin and writes what is stored in `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/amitty/credentials/token.gpg` to stdout. |
| `token-decrypt-cmd` | `"gpg --decrypt --quiet"` | The command that decrypts the stored token: it reads the file on stdin and writes the token to stdout. It runs before the screen starts, so a terminal pinentry works. |
| `proxy` | `""` | The proxy every connection to Discord goes through, such as "socks5h://127.0.0.1:9050" or "http://user:pass@host:3128"; "" connects directly. Schemes: http, https, socks5, socks5h (both SOCKS5 schemes resolve names at the proxy). The environment is not read, and nothing bypasses a set proxy. |
| `status` | `"default"` | "default" (unknown), "online", "dnd", "idle", "invisible" or "offline". |
| `hide_blocked_users` | `true` |  |
| `hide_deleted_users` | `true` | Whether to leave DMs with deleted accounts out of the guilds tree's DMs and the channels picker. |
| `messages_limit` | `20` | The number of older messages fetched per page when scrolling up through a channel, from 1 to 100. Opening a channel fetches 10 and then one page before them, as the web client does, which pages by 20. |
| `theme_profile` | `"TokyoNight"` | A color scheme every style of [theme] starts from, such as "Catppuccin Mocha", TokyoNight by default; "" keeps the terminal's own colors. Styles set under [theme] override it. The profiles are listed in docs/themes.md. The profile paints its background and text color everywhere. |
| `inherit_background` | `false` | Whether a theme profile leaves the background to the terminal, keeping its transparency, and paints only text. |

## `[theme.messages_list]`

| Option | Default | Meaning |
|--------|---------|---------|
| `author_style` | `{ foreground = "#7AA2F7", attributes = "bold" }` | The style of an author's name, such as `{ attributes = "bold" }`, `"dim"` or none for regular. |
| `author_color` | `"role"` | The color of an author's name: "role" takes the color of their highest colored role, falling back to author_style's foreground; "style" always takes author_style's foreground. |
| `mention_style` | `{ foreground = "#7AA2F7", attributes = "bold" }` |  |
| `emoji_style` | `{ foreground = "#9ECE6A" }` |  |
| `url_style` | `{ foreground = "#7DCFFF" }` |  |
| `attachment_style` | `{ foreground = "#E0AF68" }` |  |
| `reaction_style` | `{ foreground = "#61698B" }` |  |
| `own_reaction_style` | `{ foreground = "#BB9AF7", attributes = "bold" }` |  |
| `message_style` | `{ foreground = "#C0CAF5" }` |  |
| `selected_message_style` | `{ background = "#313B58" }` |  |
| `alternate_style` | `{ background = "#242632" }` | The style merged under every ui.messages_list.alternate_every-th message, such as `{ background = "#24273a" }`, to tell messages apart. A theme profile tints it from its background. |
| `reply_style` | `{ foreground = "#61698B", background = "#2E303F", attributes = "italic" }` | The style of the line above a reply quoting the message it answers. Its background, if set, fills the line, setting it apart from the reply and the alternate tint. A theme profile tints it slightly. |
